_comment: Hoodrich dealers -- the people you buy BULK from. Bulk cannot be sold until it has been
bagged up (wheel > Drugs > Bag it up).
There are two ways to get weight. The gangs sell what the gangs move, and you buy that by
walking up to their leader and asking -- none of that is in this file. Everything here is
somebody working for themselves.
Independents belong to a PLACE rather than to a crew, because that is how these trades
actually sit on a map: the coke is on the beach, the meth is out in the sand, the pills
are wherever the clubs are. They do not care who you run with and nothing has to be
unlocked to use them -- you simply have to know where to go, and they are not marked.
THE PROGRESSION: Uncle Dee is where you start. Once you have moved enough weight
(Economy > DocksUnlockGrams in Hoodrich.ini, default 50g) he names the port, which is
what makes the dock worker -- and with him the whole catalogue at the best price -- exist
for you.
kind             Docks | Independent
drugs            what they sell. EMPTY means the whole catalogue -- that is the docks.
zones            GET_NAME_OF_ZONE codes they stand in
models           ped models tried IN ORDER; first one present in your install wins
priceMultiplier  applied to the wholesale price. Below 1.0 is a better deal.
openHour/closeHour  operating hours, 0-24. Wraps midnight when open > close.
greeting / buyLine / sourceReply / sourceTooSoon / farewell  what they say to you

dealers.name: Dock Worker
dealers.greeting: Dee's people, right? Keep it quiet and keep it quick. Whatever's in the box, I can get it off the box.
dealers.buyLine: Anything you want, in weight. Say what and say how much.
dealers.sourceReply: Where do I get it? Mate, I AM where you get it.
dealers.farewell: Off you go. Don't come back in daylight if you're carrying.

dealers.name: Sunny
dealers.greeting: Look at the ocean, not at me. You want the good stuff or you want to waste my afternoon?
dealers.buyLine: Say a number. And smile, we're two guys talking on a beach.
dealers.sourceReply: Comes off a boat, same as everything nice in this city.

dealers.name: Dwayne
dealers.greeting: You drove a long way to talk to me, so you already know what I do.
dealers.buyLine: Cook's still warm. How much you want?
dealers.sourceReply: I make it. Out here nobody smells nothin' but the lake.
dealers.farewell: Don't speed on the way back. Ain't nothin' out here but troopers.

dealers.name: Mrs. Pak
dealers.greeting: You are not a customer I recognise. Speak quietly and do not stand so close.
dealers.buyLine: Tell me the amount. I do not discuss anything else.
dealers.sourceReply: That is not a question you get to ask.
dealers.farewell: Walk that way. Not the way you came.

dealers.name: Toby
dealers.greeting: Yeah yeah, you're not a cop, everyone says that. What are you after?
dealers.buyLine: How many? And don't ask me what's in them, I genuinely don't know.
dealers.sourceReply: A guy in a warehouse with a pill press. That's the whole industry, mate.
dealers.farewell: Have a good night. Try not to die.

dealers.name: Old Ray
dealers.greeting: Been on this corner since before you was born. What you need?
dealers.buyLine: Say it and say it once.
dealers.sourceReply: Everybody round here gets it from the same place. You figure out where.
